title: When AI Writes, Whose Voice Remains? Quantifying Cultural Marker Erasure Across World English Varieties in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the systematic erasure of culturally specific linguistic markers (Cultural Ghosting) by processing texts from Indian, Singaporean, and Nigerian English through LLMs and measuring the Identity Erasure Rate (IER) and Semantic Preservation Score (SPS).

Measuring the standardization of non-native World English varieties into Western English norms by tracking the removal or alteration of specific lexical, pragmatic, and syntactic markers during LLM text generation and paraphrasing tasks.
